title: Standardization of Certification Documentation
summary: The requirement for the Ministry of Industries to certify production materials and declarations became a standardized administrative procedure across various industrial sectors.

evolution.documentation: Standardization of signature and certification requirements for industrial declarations.

timeline.change: Establishment of a standardized signature block requiring the Ministry of Industries representative to certify production declarations.

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the issuing authority for this regulatory instrument regarding the declaration of raw materials and inputs for the production of electric bikes and accessories.
The document requires the signature and date of the representative from the National Board of Revenue to formalize the declaration of inputs and waste percentages.
H.S. Code: The regulation requires the formal declaration of H.S. Code for both the finished products, such as electric bikes and accessories, and the raw materials used in their production.
Value Added Tax: The document mandates the inclusion of the Value Added Tax registration number for industrial entities involved in the production of specified goods.
The relevant Value Added Tax departmental officer and the Commissioner are required to provide authentication and signatures for the declared manufacturing details.
Ministry of Industries: A representative from the Ministry of Industries must provide their name, signature, and the date of declaration to certify the production materials used by the industrial entity.

VAT Departmental Official: The document requires the name and signature of the relevant Value Added Tax departmental official along with the date of signing.
Ministry of Industries: The document requires the name and signature of a representative from the Ministry of Industries along with the date of signing.
National Board of Revenue: The document requires the name and signature of a representative from the National Board of Revenue along with the date of signing.
Commissioner of Customs: The document mandates a countersignature by the relevant Commissioner of Customs.
Management Authority: The document requires the signature and date of the management authority of the concerned organization.
